subtitle: Genesis Floor, Constitutional Amendment, and Evolution Extension

new_primitives.GENESIS_FLOOR_ID: Stable identity of the minimal meta-constitutional invariants governing legitimate constitutional evolution.
new_primitives.AMENDMENT_PROPOSAL_ID: Identifier for a proposed change to mutable constitutional policy.
new_primitives.CONSTITUTION_VERSION: Explicit version whose parent root is preserved.
new_primitives.AMENDMENT_RECEIPT: Replayable binding of proposal, floor check, host arbitration, independent attestation and resulting constitution root.

core_rule: The Genesis seed is a floor that protects legitimate evolution, not a frozen collection of every original policy preference.

two_layer_contract.genesis_floor: minimal anti-capture, provenance, appealability, explicit-versioning and non-retroactive-history rules
two_layer_contract.evolvable_layer: operational policies, evidence classes, thresholds, canonicalization profiles, emergency scopes and other explicitly mutable rules

amendment_pipeline: AMENDMENT_PROPOSAL -> GENESIS_FLOOR_CHECK -> HOST_ARBITRATION -> INDEPENDENT_ATTESTATION -> NEW_VERSION/ROOT -> FUTURE_CASES
anti_majority_rule: Face count is not amendment voting power; spawning more faces cannot manufacture constitutional legitimacy.
history_rule: A new constitution cannot erase or silently relabel earlier judicial and causal receipts. Historical cases may be reopened only through an explicit review relation preserving the original record.
verification_requirements: admit a legitimate new evidence/canonicalization policy
verify new constitution chains to exact parent root
canonical_lines: The seed protects the right to evolve without granting the right to erase how evolution occurred.
A constitution may change; its lineage may not be forged.
Future faces need freedom from the first face's preferences, not freedom from provenance and appeal.
